title.en: Modifying the Rates of Import Duty on Certain Imported Articles as Provided Under Presidential Decree No. 1464, Otherwise Known as the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978, as Amended

text.en:
The articles specifically listed in Annex "A" hereof as classified under Section 104 of Presidential
Decree No. 1464, as amended, shall pay the rates of import duty to be applied by stages in accordance with
the schedule indicated opposite each article as listed in the aforementioned Annex "A": Provided, That the
rates of duty indicated for 1985 shall continue to be levied, imposed and collected in the succeeding years
until otherwise modified.

After the expiration of thirty (30) days from the issuance of this Order, all the above-described articles
listed in Annex "A", hereof entered or withdrawn from warehouse, in the Philippines, for consumption shall
be subject to the rates of import duty herein prescribed.
Done in the City of Manila, this 16th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-one.
